descripcion_es: Condiciones irreales en el pasado; causa pasada con resultado presente y viceversa.
resumen: El tercer condicional imagina un pasado distinto y su consecuencia en el pasado (si hubiera… habría…). Los condicionales mixtos combinan una condición pasada con un resultado presente, o una situación presente con un resultado pasado.

filas: If I had left earlier, I would have caught the train.
If I had taken the job, I would live in London now.
If I spoke French, I would have understood the guide.

explicacion.texto: El tercer condicional habla de algo que no ocurrió: la condición y el resultado son ambos pasados e imposibles de cambiar. Equivale a «si hubiera hecho, habría hecho».
Nunca va would en la parte con if: If I had known (no If I would have known). En el habla, 'd puede ser had o would: If I'd known, I'd have told you.

items: Could have / might have en el resultado expresan posibilidad: If you had asked, I might have helped.
Inversión formal sin if: Had I known, I would have told you (= If I had known).
But for + nombre / If it hadn't been for + nombre: «de no ser por».
Pista para los mixtos: fíjate en las marcas temporales (now, today, yesterday, last year).

ejemplos.frase: If we had booked earlier, we would have got better seats.
ejemplos.traduccion: Si hubiéramos reservado antes, habríamos conseguido mejores asientos.

ejemplos.frase: She wouldn't have missed the flight if the taxi had arrived on time.
ejemplos.traduccion: No habría perdido el vuelo si el taxi hubiera llegado a tiempo.

ejemplos.frase: If I hadn't broken my leg, I would be playing in the final today.
ejemplos.traduccion: Si no me hubiera roto la pierna, hoy estaría jugando la final.

ejemplos.frase: If he were more careful, he wouldn't have crashed the car.
ejemplos.traduccion: Si fuera más cuidadoso, no habría estrellado el coche.

ejemplos.frase: Had the bank lowered rates sooner, the recession might have been shorter.
ejemplos.traduccion: Si el banco hubiera bajado los tipos antes, la recesión podría haber sido más corta.

ejemplos.frase: If it hadn't been for your help, I would never have finished the thesis.
ejemplos.traduccion: De no ser por tu ayuda, nunca habría terminado la tesis.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: If I would have known, I would have come.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: If I had known, I would have come.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: En la parte con if se usa had + participio, nunca would.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: If I had studied medicine, I would have been a doctor now.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: Con now el resultado es presente: condicional mixto con would + infinitivo.

errores_hispanohablantes.mal: If you would have told me, I had helped you.
errores_hispanohablantes.bien: If you had told me, I would have helped you.
errores_hispanohablantes.nota: Se invierte el orden típico del calco: had va con if y would have en el resultado.

ejercicios.enunciado: Completa con la forma correcta (tercer condicional).
ejercicios.frase: If she ___ (not / forget) her passport, she would have flown to Lisbon.
respuestas: hadn't forgotten
had not forgotten
ejercicios.explicacion: La condición irreal pasada va en past perfect.

ejercicios.enunciado: Completa con la forma correcta (tercer condicional).
ejercicios.frase: If you had asked me, I ___ (lend) you the money.
respuestas: would have lent
'd have lent
ejercicios.explicacion: El resultado del tercer condicional es would have + participio (lend → lent).

ejercicios.frase: If I had saved more when I was young, I ___ (be) rich now.
respuestas: would be
'd be
ejercicios.explicacion: Causa pasada con resultado presente (now): would + infinitivo.

ejercicios.frase: If he ___ (be) a better swimmer, he would have crossed the river easily.
respuestas: were
was
ejercicios.explicacion: Rasgo presente y permanente (no es buen nadador) con resultado pasado: pasado simple en la condición.

ejercicios.frase: If they ___ the warning signs, the accident wouldn't have happened.
respuestas: had noticed

ejercicios.frase: If I hadn't missed the bus this morning, I ___ late for work now.
respuestas: wouldn't be
ejercicios.explicacion: Causa pasada, resultado presente (now): condicional mixto.

ejercicios.frase: ___ for the rain, we would have finished the match.
respuestas: If it hadn't been
ejercicios.explicacion: If it hadn't been for = de no ser por (en pasado).

ejercicios.frase: If we would have left earlier, we would have avoided the traffic.
respuestas: If we had left earlier, we would have avoided the traffic.
If we'd left earlier, we would have avoided the traffic.
If we had left earlier, we'd have avoided the traffic.
ejercicios.explicacion: No se usa would en la parte con if.

ejercicios.frase: If I had accepted that offer, I would have lived in Canada now.
respuestas: If I had accepted that offer, I would live in Canada now.
If I had accepted that offer, I'd live in Canada now.
If I'd accepted that offer, I would live in Canada now.
ejercicios.explicacion: Con now el resultado es presente: would + infinitivo.

ejercicios.frase: If she had studied harder, she would pass the exam last June.
respuestas: If she had studied harder, she would have passed the exam last June.
If she had studied harder, she'd have passed the exam last June.
ejercicios.explicacion: El resultado se refiere al pasado (last June): would have + participio.

ejercicios.enunciado: Une las ideas en una frase con tercer condicional que empiece por If.
ejercicios.frase: I didn't know you were ill, so I didn't visit you.
respuestas: If I had known you were ill, I would have visited you.
If I'd known you were ill, I would have visited you.
If I had known you were ill, I'd have visited you.
If I'd known you were ill, I'd have visited you.
ejercicios.explicacion: Se invierten las dos realidades negativas en hipótesis afirmativas.

ejercicios.enunciado: Reescribe la frase con inversión, sin if.
ejercicios.frase: If I had known about the strike, I would have taken the car.
respuestas: Had I known about the strike, I would have taken the car.
Had I known about the strike, I'd have taken the car.
ejercicios.explicacion: En registro formal, had pasa delante del sujeto y desaparece if.

ejercicios.enunciado: Une las ideas en un condicional mixto que empiece por If.
ejercicios.frase: He didn't take the medicine, so he is ill now.
respuestas: If he had taken the medicine, he wouldn't be ill now.
If he had taken the medicine, he would not be ill now.
If he'd taken the medicine, he wouldn't be ill now.
ejercicios.explicacion: Causa pasada (past perfect) y resultado presente (would + infinitivo).

respuestas: if you had called I would have come
I would have come if you had called
ejercicios.explicacion: If + past perfect, would have + participio.

respuestas: they might have won the game
ejercicios.explicacion: Might have + participio expresa un resultado posible, no seguro.
